# flutter_localizations and intl

**Version:** `flutter_localizations` (SDK), `intl ^0.20.2`. **Wrapped by:** `ui/core/l10n`; `AppLocalizations` is generated by
`flutter pub get` / `flutter run` / `flutter test` from [`l10n.yaml`](../../../l10n.yaml) (`generate: true` in `pubspec.yaml`).
Mechanism: [Localization](../../architecture/cross-cutting/localization.md). Decision: [ADR 0015](../../adr/0015-localization-gen-l10n.md).
